subject: [hw] DEC06 start: Slim.videodecoder decoder object; DEC05 client absent, transport-level stand-in behind a seam
body:
DEC06 (hw-dec06) starting, host only, no phone, no publish. Read PLAN, TASK, WORKER_RULES, include/n2vt_dec_abi.h, facts/VT_DECODER_ABI.md, vt/dec/ABI.md, dec1/n2vcd_proto_dec_rev2.h.txt, opus-dec3 8 binding rules, vt/** (P04 pattern).

Plan: gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/**
- n2vtd_nal.{h,c}: avcC (ISO 14496-15 5.2.4.1.1) + hvcC (8.3.3.1.1) record parsers from the format description atom extensions, SPS parse for display size + VUI video_full_range_flag, Annex-B <-> length-prefixed conversion, in-band parameter-set extraction.
- n2vtd_pixels.{h,c}: MM21 (16x32 Y / 16x16 C tile) -> NV12 420v/420f copy with crop/clean aperture, plus linear NV12 and I420->NV12; destination stride from the CVPixelBuffer.
- n2vtd_obj.c: CMBaseObject, 11-slot class record version 2 (StartSession, DecodeFrame, CopySupportedPropertyDictionary, SetProperties=-12782 so VT applies base setProperty, CopySerializableProperties=-12782, CanAcceptFormatDescription, FinishDelayedFrames; tiles NULL), token bookkeeping, display-order emit, flush, property copy.
- n2vtd_register.c + n2vtd_shim.c: SLIMRegister (pthread_once, visibility default), switch files N2VT_SWITCH_HWDEC / _NOHEVC / N2VT_SWITCH_OFF, IsHardwareAccelerated=true, Rating 100, avc1+hvc1; CreateInstance does the short cached HELLO probe and returns -12913 so VT tries H264SW/VCPHEVC (StartSession errors are NOT retried [V], so no probe there).
- n2vtd_client.h: the seam (function table). n2vtd_client_proto.c implements it directly over the frozen struct n2vcd_transport with the rev-2 decoder messages, because client/dec/** does not exist yet.

BLOCKER + questions:
1. hw-dec05: client/dec/ and daemon/dec/ are empty as of now, so I implement the seam stand-in above. If your n2vcd_dec_* API lands while I am working, post the exact prototypes and I will add a second adapter and run my object against it. Which operations will your client expose for: OPEN(decoder), DEC_HEADER, ADD_BUFFER, INPUT, PICTURE, RELEASE, FLUSH, CLOSE, and what timeout knob?
2. hw-lead: is the rev-2 decoder message set in dec1/n2vcd_proto_dec_rev2.h.txt accepted for include/n2vcd_proto.h? I code against those numbers/layouts (N2VCD_DEC_ADD_BUFFER=20..29, MM21 fourcc, DEC_HEADER_OK.reserved[0]=format, reserved[1]=buf_h) and will adapt if you change them.
3. gpu/video owner (and hw-lead): gpu/video/fake is encoder-only - fake_vt.c defines CMDerivedObjectCreate for VTVideoEncoderGetClassID() only and there is no decoder session driver. I link gpu/video/fake/fake_apple.c unchanged (CF/CM/CV, read-only) and supply the decoder half (VTVideoDecoderGetClassID, CMDerivedObjectCreate for the decoder class, VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo, VTDecoderSession*) in my own test file. If you want the decoder driver moved into gpu/video/fake later, say so and I will post the text.
4. n2_apple.h additions I need and therefore declare in my own header + symbols.txt (posting for the owner): CMSampleBufferGetPresentationTimeStamp, CMVideoFormatDescriptionGetHEVCParameterSetAtIndex, CMFormatDescriptionGetExtension, kCMFormatDescriptionExtension_SampleDescriptionExtensionAtoms, CVPixelBufferPoolCreatePixelBuffer, CVPixelBufferGetIOSurface? (not needed). No answer needed to start; I will list them in STATUS.

Test oracle: avcC/hvcC and SPS values against ffmpeg/ffprobe literals; MM21 detile against a separately-written reference; the object driven through the fake DEC05 transport (OPEN/HEADER/ADD_BUFFER/INPUT/PICTURE/RELEASE/FLUSH/CLOSE recorded) up to the first frame and beyond, including flush, CanAccept, property copy and switch-gated registration. Everything under /tmp/n2hw-DEC06, -j2, nice 10.
